rendered:
The target shared under the same name is STAT3. In Table 1[1] it appears in the target cell TLR9 receptor; STAT3[2] of the CpG-STAT3 entry, and in Table 2[3] as the target of the STAT3 siRNA entry: STAT3[4].

There are also overlaps by related name. Table 1[5] lists KRAS (G12D)[6] and KrasG12D[7] as targets, and Table 2[8] lists KRAS TGF-β[9] (a KRAS siRNA co-delivered with TGF-β siRNA), so KRAS is shared in substance.

TGF-β is also shared in part: Table 1[10] lists TGF-β1 COX- 2[11] as a target, and Table 2[12] lists TGF-β1[13].

Apart from these, the remaining target names in the first table do not appear in the target column of the second.
